Goals:
relieve crowding
improve OJ
reduce AOB
(bonded upper wire 2-2 will be removed)


Dentist's Requests (e.g. delaying attachments):  nil

Canine and Molar Classification - Where would you like to end up? :  accept 

AP Plane Correction:  reduce OJ.

Final Overjet Goals (mm):  2-2.5mm

Vertical Plane Correction:  reduce AOB

Final Overbite Goals (mm):  +1mm

Transverse Plane Correction:  no

How to Resolve Crowding (IPR, staging of movement etc.):
UPPER:
IPR U3-3.
extrude U2-2 by 0.5mm.
add distal crown angulation UL2.
retract U2-2 for part OJ reduction.
maintain midlines.

LOWER:
procline LR2, LL1, LL2 into arch.
add lingual root torque LR1.
extrude L2-2 for open bite. 
IPR L3-3 as needed and round tip incisors.
aim for 2-3mm OJ. 
accept buccal segments.
